verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio (the UI) explicitly supports exporting and running agent teams as Python code (autogen-docs-5, autogen-docs-17), indicating the UI is essentially a wrapper over the same AgentChat API, and the core agent/team/tool capabilities (AssistantAgent, RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, etc.) are all documented as code-first APIs. However, some UI-specific conveniences (test endpoint setup, docker container running, drag-and-drop visual builder, community gallery browsing) are not confirmed to have direct API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all AutoGen Studio UI features (endpoint testing, docker run, gallery import) are fully scriptable via the API, and independent corroboration beyond docs.
